text: 金十数据7月13日讯，国务院批复《扩大消费“十五五”规划》，目标到2030年，消费市场总体规模持续扩大，居民消费率明显提高，全社会商品和服务消费较快增长，社会消费品零售总额达到60万亿元左右，消费对经济增长的拉动作用进一步增强。消费结构更加优化，居民人均服务性消费支出占居民人均消费支出的比重稳步提高，发展型、改善型消费持续增长，数字消费规模不断扩大，城乡、区域、群体间消费差距逐步缩小。消费能力不断提高，高质量充分就业取得新进展，居民收入增长和经济增长同步，社会保障制度更加优化更可持续，居民消费底气更足、预期更稳、信心更强。
text_en: Jin Shi Data July 13 - The State Council approved the '15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption', aiming to continuously expand the overall scale of the consumer market by 2030, significantly increase the household consumption rate, achieve rapid growth in consumption of goods and services across society, with total retail sales of consumer goods reaching around 60 trillion yuan, further enhancing consumption's role in driving economic growth. The consumption structure will be more optimized, with the share of per capita service consumption expenditure steadily rising, developmental and improvement-oriented consumption growing, digital consumption expanding, and consumption gaps between urban and rural areas, regions, and groups gradually narrowing. Consumption capacity will improve, new progress will be made in high-quality full employment, household income growth will be synchronized with economic growth, the social security system will be more optimized and sustainable, and residents will have a stronger foundation, more stable expectations, and greater confidence in consumption.
